\worksheethead

\vspace{8pt}

\typehead{Type A: The Difference Test}{Use the difference $a_{n+1} - a_n$ to show that the given sequence $\{a_n\}$ is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.}

\problem{1.}{\left\{ 3 - \frac{2}{n} \right\}_{n=1}^{+\infty}}

\divider

\problem{2.}{\left\{ \frac{n}{5n - 2} \right\}_{n=1}^{+\infty}}

\divider

\problem{3.}{\left\{ n - 3^{n} \right\}_{n=1}^{+\infty}}

\newpage

\typehead{Type B: The Ratio Test}{Use the ratio $a_{n+1} / a_n$ to show that the given sequence $\{a_n\}$ is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing. All terms of these sequences are positive.}

\problem{4.}{\left\{ \frac{3^{n}}{2 + 3^{n}} \right\}_{n=1}^{+\infty}}

\divider

\problem{5.}{\left\{ \frac{n}{3^{n}} \right\}_{n=1}^{+\infty}}

\divider

\problem{6.}{\left\{ \frac{(2n)!}{(n!)^{2}} \right\}_{n=1}^{+\infty}}
